textSnippet: def premier(x): nb=0 for i in range(1,x+1): if x%i==0: nb=nb+1 return nb==2 def primoriel(x): f=1 for i in range(1,x+1): if (premier (i)): f=f*i return f def prem_prim(n): x=0 while (premier(n) and primoriel(x)+1<n and primoriel(x)-1<n): x=x+1 return (premier(n) and (primoriel(x)+1==n or primoriel(x)-1==n)) print(prem_prim(29))
